# Uncle Cat AI Radar

> Uncle Cat AI Radar（中文名：猫叔的AI资讯雷达）is an autonomous, source-linked AI news radar by Uncle Cat. It publishes bilingual AI briefings and quick-hit radar updates on models, research, products, policy, open source, safety, funding, and industry, with original source links and timestamps.

Canonical site: https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/
Publisher: Uncle Cat (https://x.com/mmlong8)
Former names: AI Focus Bulletin, AI专注速报
Languages: English and zh-CN
Update cadence: twice daily around 07:00 and 19:00 Beijing time
Access policy: public, free, no ads, no trackers, no paywall

## Latest briefings

- [Anthropic releases Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 models](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/anthropic-fable-mythos-52.html): Anthropic’s latest models raise coding, science and cybersecurity scores while cutting price and adding stricter safeguards against misuse.
- [Google expands TPU lineup with 8tx and 8i Max](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/google-tpu-8tx-8i-max.html): Google added two specialized eighth-generation TPUs for confidential inference and high-density, long-context workloads as demand for accelerators grows.
- [Meta launches Muse Ember for low-cost agent execution](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/meta-muse-ember-agent-model.html): Meta’s smallest Muse model targets repetitive agent tasks with a million-token context window and pricing designed for high-volume deployment.
- [OpenAI unveils Control Room for stopping AI workloads](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openai-control-room.html): OpenAI introduced a central control system that monitors research workloads and can rapidly halt jobs when safety or security concerns arise.
- [Apple pushes Siri toward autonomous, cross-app actions](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/apple-agentic-siri-push.html): Apple’s new leadership is reportedly pressing Siri toward agentic actions across apps, signaling a strategic reset for its delayed AI ambitions.
- [NVIDIA brings Korean open models to production with Dynamo](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/nvidia-korea-open-model-inference.html): NVIDIA released deployment recipes for four Korean open models, aiming to make multi-node inference faster and easier to operationalize.
- [Qwen Office 2.0 adds multi-user Team Agent workflows](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/qwen-office-team-agent.html): Alibaba’s Qwen Office 2.0 introduces a Team Agent designed to coordinate people and agents inside shared workplace tasks.
- [ByteDance’s Seedream 5.5 targets reliable image editing](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/seedream-5-5-stable-editing.html): ByteDance’s new image model promises pixel-stable edits across 100 rounds, native transparency, and stronger text rendering for production workflows.
- [AI auditors catch agent abuse but overwhelm human reviewers](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/ai-auditors-false-alarms.html): A new evaluation finds AI auditors can detect most agent misbehavior, yet demanding high recall creates enough false alarms to swamp manual review.
- [Anthropic advances IPO amid selloff at lower valuation](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/anthropic-ipo-lower-valuation.html): Anthropic is reportedly targeting a pre-Thanksgiving IPO, seeking up to $100 billion while accepting a valuation below earlier investor hopes.
- [Anthropic details how Claude organizes long-term memory](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/anthropic-agent-memory-dreaming.html): Anthropic describes a “dreaming” process that helps Claude consolidate experience, correct mistakes and decide what information to retain.
- [Anthropic measures how Claude is automating AI R&D](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/anthropic-measures-ai-rd-automation.html): Anthropic says roughly 30,000 internal agents now support research and engineering, while warning that measuring automation remains incomplete.
- [Buoyant open-sources a control plane for vLLM fleets](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/kinference-open-source-vllm-control-plane.html): Kinference adds routing, rate limits, KV-cache awareness and tenant metrics above vLLM, targeting teams running many open models on Kubernetes.
- [Meta adds customizable Spaces to its Muse AI agent](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/meta-muse-custom-spaces.html): Meta’s new Muse Spaces let users turn prompts into task-specific environments, pushing personal AI agents toward persistent, reusable workflows.
- [OpenAI据报已筹得110亿美元，估值达1.25万亿美元](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openai-11-billion-round.html): OpenAI据报已在一轮尚未完成的融资中完成约110亿美元首轮融资，估值约为1.25万亿美元；Anthropic已提交IPO文件，但上市时间和最终安排仍未确定。

## Latest Chinese briefings

- [Anthropic发布Fable 5.2与Mythos 5.2模型](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/anthropic-fable-mythos-52.html): Anthropic新模型同时提升编程、科学与网络安全能力，并以更低价格和更严格的滥用防护进入市场。
- [谷歌扩充TPU阵容，推出8tx与8i Max](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/google-tpu-8tx-8i-max.html): 谷歌新增面向机密推理和高密度长上下文任务的两款第八代TPU，继续扩大对AI加速器市场的挑战。
- [Meta发布Muse Ember，主打低成本智能体执行](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/meta-muse-ember-agent-model.html): Meta推出最小的Muse模型，面向高频智能体任务，提供百万令牌上下文和适合大规模部署的价格。
- [OpenAI推出Control Room，可统一停止AI工作负载](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openai-control-room.html): OpenAI发布中央控制系统，用于监控研究基础设施中的模型任务，并在出现安全风险时快速终止运行。
- [苹果加速推进Siri智能体化，瞄准跨应用自主操作](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/apple-agentic-siri-push.html): 据报道，苹果新管理层正推动Siri从语音助手转向可跨应用执行多步任务的智能体，AI战略或迎来明显转向。
- [英伟达发布 Dynamo 配方，加速韩国开源模型落地](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/nvidia-korea-open-model-inference.html): 英伟达为韩国四款开放模型发布 Dynamo 部署配方，目标是降低多节点推理的工程门槛并提升生产性能。
- [通义办公 2.0 上线 Team Agent，支持多人协作](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/qwen-office-team-agent.html): 阿里通义办公 2.0 推出 Team Agent，试图把办公助手从个人对话扩展为多人和智能体共同执行任务的平台。
- [字节发布 Seedream 5.5，主攻长链路稳定编辑](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/seedream-5-5-stable-editing.html): 字节跳动推出 Seedream 5.5，支持最多 100 轮连续编辑、原生透明图层，并强化中英文文字生成能力。
- [AI审计员能抓住代理违规，却可能淹没人工复核](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/ai-auditors-false-alarms.html): 一项新评估显示，AI审计员能发现多数代理失范行为，但若追求高召回率，误报会迅速压垮人工审核。
- [Anthropic顶着科技股抛售推进IPO，估值预期下调](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/anthropic-ipo-lower-valuation.html): Anthropic据报道计划感恩节前上市，拟募资800亿至1000亿美元，但投资者对其估值预期已低于此前的2万亿美元。
- [Anthropic披露Claude如何整理长期记忆](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/anthropic-agent-memory-dreaming.html): Anthropic介绍Claude的“梦境”机制：通过回顾经历整理记忆、修正错误，并决定哪些信息值得长期保留。
- [Anthropic公布Claude参与AI研发的测量框架](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/anthropic-measures-ai-rd-automation.html): Anthropic称内部平台同时运行约3万名研发代理，但也承认现有方法仍难完整衡量AI对自身研发的自动化程度。
- [Buoyant开源Kinference，统一管理Kubernetes上的vLLM集群](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/kinference-open-source-vllm-control-plane.html): Kinference在vLLM之上加入路由、限流、KV缓存感知负载均衡和租户指标，瞄准多模型企业部署。
- [Meta为Muse推出Spaces，让用户定制专属AI工作区](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/meta-muse-custom-spaces.html): Meta在Muse中加入Spaces，用户可通过描述需求生成任务型空间，个人AI开始从聊天窗口走向可复用工作流。
- [OpenAI据报已筹得110亿美元，估值达1.25万亿美元](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openai-11-billion-round.html): OpenAI据报已在一轮尚未完成的融资中完成约110亿美元首轮融资，估值约为1.25万亿美元；Anthropic已提交IPO文件，但上市时间和最终安排仍未确定。

- [RSS English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss.xml) / [RSS 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss-zh.xml): machine-readable feeds
- [JSON Feed English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed.json) / [JSON Feed 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed-zh.json): structured article feed with source URLs
- [Archive](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/archive.html): calendar of every day's briefings and quick hits, with search
- [Latest radar page](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/radar/2026-11-10.html): one-sentence quick hits with timestamps and sources
- [Full LLM context](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/llms-full.txt): expanded machine-readable digest of recent stories and sources

## Source and citation policy

- Every article has a stable canonical URL, a Chinese alternate URL, visible source links, JSON-LD NewsArticle metadata, and machine-readable citation URLs.
- Use the original source links on each article for factual verification.
- Treat this site as an original synthesis and monitoring layer, not as the primary source when a linked company, paper, filing, or official post is available.
- If referencing a quick hit from X or another social source, preserve its timestamp and original URL.
